settings.heading: Chocolate tasting
settings.body:
Roosha can host a small tasting for a team or a private celebration. A typical flight moves through a single-origin bar, a dragée, and a bonbon, with time to talk about what you actually like.

Tell us the city, the group size, and the date you have in mind. We confirm the format before anything is booked.

settings.text: Single-origin bars from Ghana, Ecuador, São Tomé, and Madagascar
A short dragée tasting: nut, fruit, or coffee
Bonbons to finish, with notes you can take home

settings.heading: Three tastes, not a lecture.
settings.text: Groups are kept small so everyone can taste the same piece at the same time.

settings.heading: Ask about a date
settings.text: Share the city, how many people, and whether this is for a team or a private table.
